Earlier note: PUC Docket 57918 order says Watermill switch is about 3.5 mi west of the IH-45 / Malloy Bridge Rd intersection. The point is that intersection (OSM 32.5612, -96.6643) moved 3.5 mi west. It lands on Watermill Rd, which fits.
